description: Put a ticket directly above (before) or below (after) another ticket in the same panel. This is how the backlog is prioritised. Moving between panels is update_ticket or transition_ticket.

after.description: Put it directly below this ticket

before.description: Put it directly above this ticket

workspace_id.description: Workspace ID, as list_workspaces gives it. Defaults to the one workspace this connection reaches; required when it reaches several.

name: move_ticket
title: Move a ticket
